disableSessionTracking.title: when true, API invocations are private (no agent_sessions entries)

clearTools.description: Explicitly clears tools. Repeated fields do not preserve presence when encoded empty, so clients cannot otherwise distinguish clear from omit.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AgentDefinition.description: AgentDefinition is the blueprint/config for an agent.

disableSessionTracking.title: when true, API invocations do NOT create agent_sessions entries

v1AgentExecutionPolicy.description: AgentExecutionPolicy is a typed policy container for runtime controls.

v1AgentMemoryConfig.description: AgentMemoryConfig configures persistent memory for an agent.

v1AgentMemoryEntry.description: AgentMemoryEntry represents a single persistent memory entry.

v1AgentMode.description: AgentMode controls whether an agent is user-facing or delegation-only.

v1AgentSession.description: AgentSession is an execution instance of an agent.

v1AgentSessionTurn.description: AgentSessionTurn is a single conversation turn within a session.

v1ApprovalAction.description: ApprovalAction is the action to take on a review.

v1ApprovalReview.description:
ApprovalReview represents a HITL approval review for tool calls.
V1 is single-instance; multi-instance via Redis pub/sub is v2.

v1ApprovalReviewStatus.description: ApprovalReviewStatus tracks the lifecycle of an approval review.

webhookSecret.title: only set for webhook triggers (raw secret, shown once)

idleRetentionSeconds.description:
Idle retention in seconds. 0 means no expiration (pro/enterprise).
When omitted, the server resolves retention from the tenant's plan tier.

templateId.description: If set, use template config as base. Individual fields override template defaults.

name.description: Optional friendly name for the sandbox.
Friendly name for the sandbox (if set).

isExposed.title: true if already exposed via ExposePort

v1PendingToolCall.description: PendingToolCall describes a tool call awaiting approval.

sandboxId.title: ID of the expired sandbox to clone config from

sessionId.title: New session ID (optional, auto-generated if empty)

v1SandboxExecution.description: SandboxExecution represents a single command execution within a sandbox.

destroyReason.description: destroy_reason indicates why the sandbox was destroyed: manual, expired, error, system.

name.description: Friendly name for the sandbox (if set).

lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle state (Phase 3): running, stopping, stopped, reviving, terminating, terminated, failed

v1SandboxInstance.description: SandboxInstance represents a running sandbox environment.

aggregateCpuPercent.description: Aggregate resource usage across all running instances.

v1SandboxOverview.description: SandboxOverview provides a summary of the sandbox subsystem.

v1SandboxStats.description: SandboxStats holds a point-in-time resource usage snapshot.

v1SandboxStatus.description: SandboxStatus tracks the lifecycle of a sandbox instance.

v1SessionStatus.description: SessionStatus tracks the lifecycle of an agent session.

v1SpawnTreeNode.description: SpawnTreeNode represents a node in an agent spawn hierarchy.

v1TaskPermissionMode.description: TaskPermissionMode controls delegation behavior for task/spawn execution.

v1ToolCallDecision.description: ToolCallDecision is a per-tool approval decision (v2: per-tool overrides).

v1TurnStatus.description: TurnStatus tracks the lifecycle of a single turn.
